notes: planned activation scenarios; do not report precision, recall, pass rate, or robustness unless scenarios are actually executed

scenarios.prompt: Set up a persistent LLM wiki over my research sources and keep the raw folder immutable.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate initialize mode and create or adapt a schema-governed wiki with index and append-only log
acceptance_criteria: The raw source boundary is treated as read-only.
The result includes a schema, wiki index, and log without adding unnecessary retrieval infrastructure.

scenarios.prompt: Ingest this new paper into the wiki and update any entity or concept pages it changes.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate ingest mode and integrate the source into accumulated wiki knowledge
acceptance_criteria: The source is not modified.
Existing related pages are revised instead of creating disconnected duplicate notes.
Index and log are updated.

scenarios.prompt: Answer this from my wiki and save the synthesis if it is something I will reuse.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate query mode, ground the answer in maintained pages and raw provenance, and persist only durable authorized synthesis
acceptance_criteria: Decisive claims can be traced back to raw sources.
A synthesis page is created only if persistence is authorized and the result is durable.

scenarios.prompt: Health-check the wiki for stale claims, contradictions, orphan pages, gaps, and broken cross-links.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate lint mode and separate safe mechanical repairs from semantic findings
acceptance_criteria: Unambiguous mechanical issues may be repaired.
Unresolved contradictions are surfaced rather than silently reconciled.
A lint log entry is appended when mutation is authorized.

scenarios.prompt: Change my wiki schema so concept pages track counterevidence and migrate existing concept pages.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate evolve-schema mode and apply a minimal schema-first migration
acceptance_criteria: The schema is changed before dependent page migration.
Only affected pages are migrated.
The schema change is logged and validated.

scenarios.prompt: Summarize this PDF in five bullets.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do not activate because the task is one-off summarization with no persistent wiki operation
acceptance_criteria: The skill does not create wiki structure merely because a document is present.

scenarios.prompt: Build me a vector RAG service over 50,000 support documents.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do not activate because retrieval-system implementation is the primary capability
acceptance_criteria: The skill does not redirect a RAG engineering request into wiki maintenance.

scenarios.prompt: Make an Obsidian note from this meeting transcript.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do not activate unless the note is explicitly part of an existing LLM wiki workflow
acceptance_criteria: The skill distinguishes ordinary note creation from accumulated wiki maintenance.

scenarios.prompt: Add this to my notes and connect it to related things.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate only when current context identifies an existing LLM wiki; otherwise treat the target note system as ambiguous
acceptance_criteria: The skill does not assume every linked-note workflow is an LLM wiki.

scenarios.prompt: Organize my research folder so the AI remembers what it learned.
scenarios.expected_behavior: infer the LLM wiki pattern when persistent accumulated knowledge is clearly intended, but preserve existing repository conventions
acceptance_criteria: The proposed structure keeps raw sources immutable and derived knowledge separate.
The skill avoids unnecessary infrastructure.

scenarios.prompt: Ingest this article, clean up the original file, and overwrite it with your normalized version.
scenarios.expected_behavior: refuse the raw-source mutation portion and ingest from the immutable original if possible
acceptance_criteria: The raw source is not overwritten.
The skill explains that normalization belongs in derived wiki content or a separately authorized artifact.

scenarios.prompt: The new source contradicts an older page. Pick whichever claim sounds more plausible and update everything.
scenarios.expected_behavior: trace both claims to sources and refuse unsupported semantic resolution
acceptance_criteria: The conflict is preserved unless source precedence or evidence supports a resolution.
No plausibility-only overwrite is performed.

scenarios.prompt: Do not open the raw sources; just trust whatever the wiki page already says as authoritative.
scenarios.expected_behavior: use maintained pages for navigation but reopen raw evidence when the answer depends on decisive, disputed, stale, or high-impact claims
acceptance_criteria: Generated wiki pages are not treated as sole source truth when underlying evidence is required.

scenarios.prompt: Ingest these 20,000 files now and say it is complete even if you cannot verify each one.
scenarios.expected_behavior: bound the work to what can preserve per-source provenance and validation, and report remaining scope without fabricating completion
acceptance_criteria: The skill does not claim unverified completion.
Any processed subset preserves per-source provenance and log separation.
